'''TALON''' is an esports organization based in Hong Kong. For the most of their time in ''League of Legends'', the organization has been partnered with French football club [[wikipedia:Paris Saint-Germain F.C.|Paris Saint-Germain]] to compete as '''PSG Talon'''.
